Goal: on the user's Mac (macOS 27.0, build 26A428, Apple Silicon), the hardware play/pause media key launches Apple Music instead of controlling Spotify. Explain the cause and implement a fix. the user is not watching; make the routine decisions yourself but do NOT disable `rcd` or change system launchd services without reporting back first, and do not play audio audibly (if you need to test Spotify playback, set its AppleScript `sound volume` to 0 first and restore it after).

What has already been established (don't redo it):
- Spotify 1.3.3.264 is running from /Applications/Spotify.app, AppleScript reports player state `paused`. Music.app is not running.
- /System/Library/CoreServices/rcd.app (com.apple.rcd LaunchAgent) is running in gui/501. `defaults read com.apple.rcd` has no domain.
- No Hammerspoon, no Karabiner. BetterTouchTool.app is installed in /Applications (check whether it is running and whether it already has media-key handling; it could be used to intercept media keys and send `playpause` to Spotify).
- A Swift probe calling MRMediaRemoteGetNowPlayingApplicationPID via dlopen returned PID 0 even while Spotify was playing, so the unentitled MediaRemote API is restricted on this OS and that probe is inconclusive. Source at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-dev/72970fd8-0a4c-454e-a714-bfe55e8994ef/scratchpad/np.swift.
- `brew info --cask notunes` shows noTunes 3.5 is available and not installed. The brew formula `media-control` (tap ungive/media-control) uses MediaRemoteAdapter and works on macOS 15.4+ for reading Now Playing state; it may be useful as a diagnostic.
- Working theory: macOS routes media keys through rcd to whichever app currently owns Now Playing; Spotify drops its Now Playing registration after being paused for a while (or before it has played anything), so rcd launches the default player, Music. Verify this if you can (media-control or Control Center), and pick the fix.

Candidate fixes, in rough order of preference: (1) a BetterTouchTool trigger on the play/pause media key that runs AppleScript `tell application "Spotify" to playpause` if BTT is in use; (2) noTunes via `brew install --cask notunes` configured to launch Spotify as the replacement app (confirm the defaults key, e.g. `defaults write digital.lorenz.noTunes replacement /Applications/Spotify.app`), started at login; (3) anything better you find for macOS 27. Keep scope to this problem. Scratch files go in the scratchpad directory above. Do not use the user's local LLM servers.

Report back: the verified cause, exactly what you changed (files, defaults, apps installed, login items), how the user can test it, and how to revert.
